name: wolf3d
title: Wolfenstein 3D (id Software, Borland C++ 3.0 / DOS)
_doc: THE THIRD 16-BIT TARGET, on Keen Dreams' and Catacomb 3-D's recipe: the same id engine generation, Borland C++ 3.0, MODEL MEDIUM. VERSION.H selects the six-episode build (GOODTIMES, no UPLOAD, no SPEAR), which is the id/Activision 1.4 data the source's GFXV_WL6.H numbers (P11.7). What it adds: VGA mode 13h unchained (ID_VL), and wall and sprite scalers the program compiles at run time (WL_SCALE.C BuildCompScale), the boundary of P11.4.
_units: The project's own item list, read out of WOLF3D.PRJ in order. 22 C units.
_compile: The options PRJCFG reads out of WOLF3D.PRJ (goldens/borland-prj.json): -mm -3 -a, no -K (plain char SIGNED), no -b- (enums int).

VGAClearScreen._why: Its asm does mov cl,bl / rep stosw and never writes CH, and Borland compiles nothing before it that writes CX (WOLF3D.EXE 0EBC:0A0B). Its one caller, ThreeDRefresh, runs its own mov cx,0x800 / rep stosw just before the call (0EBC:0F28), which leaves CX = 0.

compile._codeWriters: ScaleLine (WL_SCALE.C) patches a RETF into a compiled scaler before each call and restores the byte after; the x86 executor must see both stores.
